# Meridian Flow

> Meridian Flow is an AI writing app for fiction writers producing long web serials (LitRPG, progression fantasy, and other genres published chapter by chapter), at 100+ chapters and thousands of words a day. The writer writes alongside Muse, an AI agent that drafts, revises and plans with them, and sends helper agents to read as a serial reader, critique, and check continuity against the story's own world pages.

Meridian Flow is for writers who need Scrivener-scale organisation without its complexity:

- Project: a whole serial, its chapters and its world pages (characters, places, rules, history), kept in one place.
- Knowledge base: the story bible, with a page for each character, place and rule. Agents look things up in it as they work and update a page when the writer asks.
- Muse and helpers: Muse is the main agent the writer talks to. It sends helpers out on a chapter: Reader-sim reads it the way a serial reader would, Critic finds what doesn't work, Writer-helper drafts alternatives, and Continuity-checker compares it against the knowledge base.
- Edits land without approval prompts: every change an agent makes can be taken back, so the writer reviews instead of approving every step.
- Writing together: the writer and the agents can edit the same document at once without losing each other's text.
- Billing: credits that agent work draws down.
